synthesis.evidence_balance: mixed — net-cash, FCF-positive, faster-than-peer growth offset by multi-year margin erosion and management-flagged worsening second-half demand visibility.

bull_points.claim: Absolute EBITDA has RISEN across the de-rate window (628 in 2021 to 731 LTM Mar-2026) and absolute revenue grew to 5,555, so the falling margin % overstates deterioration — the business is larger, not shrinking.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Income Statement (margin % + absolute EBITDA reconciler)

bull_points.claim: The balance sheet is net cash (net-debt/EBITDA -1.0x) with FCF positive ($692.9M levered FCF LTM) and self-funding with no maturity wall until 2030 — there is no runway or solvency constraint.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Net Debt ÷ CIQ LTM EBITDA (EDGAR XBRL breadth fallback) + FCF sign + CIQ Capital Structure (survival capacity)

bull_points.claim: On the decomposition inputs the name grows faster than peers (rev growth 14% vs peer-median 1%; EBITDA growth 6% vs 2%; LT EPS growth 10% vs 8%) with far lower leverage (Debt/EBITDA 0.4 vs 1.5), so part of the peer discount is not explained by worse fundamentals — POSE whether the discount is RESIDUAL (overshoot) rather than EARNED; the heterogeneous peer set (caps $734M-$77.7B, 106x span) gates this as a confidence-gated input, not a clean benchmark.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Comparable Analysis→Operating Statistics (name vs peer median: growth/margin/leverage/beta)

bull_points.claim: The company is buying back stock (share count -8.2% over ~1.7y, 56.9M to 52.2M), consistent with self-funded capital return rather than distress.
Revenue still grew +7.6% YoY in the latest same quarter (Q1 Mar-31-2026 vs Q1 Mar-31-2025), so the top line is expanding, not contracting, into the de-rate.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Income Statement + Segments + Ratios (multi-year columns)

bull_points.claim: Management frames the second-half visibility shortfall as a temporary shift in timing and direction, with AI-native pure revenue exceeding $125M in Q1 (~20% sequential growth) and a $600M full-year target line of sight, plus an accelerating large-deal pipeline not yet in the outlook.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ transcript(s): EPAM Systems, Inc., Q1 2026 Earnings Call, May 07, 2026.rtf; EPAM Systems, Inc., Q4 2025 Earnings Call, Feb 19, 2026.rtf

bear_points.claim: Both margin trend AND absolute EBITDA confirm operating deterioration is REAL, not just an optical % effect: EBITDA margin fell 17% (2021) to 13% (LTM) and gross margin 34% to 29%, while ROIC slid from 13.7% to ~10.1% — the per-unit profitability has genuinely eroded even as scale grew.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Income Statement (margin % + absolute EBITDA reconciler)

bear_points.claim: Management's own posture has WORSENED quarter-over-quarter: more macro uncertainty than 90 days ago, explicit North America underperformance, lower second-half visibility, and expected Q2 impact on larger discretionary programs — a deteriorating demand signal from the source.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ transcript(s): EPAM Systems, Inc., Q1 2026 Earnings Call, May 07, 2026.rtf; EPAM Systems, Inc., Q4 2025 Earnings Call, Feb 19, 2026.rtf

bear_points.claim: On fundamentals that justify a discount, the name's EBITDA margin is 13% vs peer-median 17% and its beta is 1.4 vs peer-median 0.8 — a genuinely lower-margin, higher-volatility profile that EARNS part of the cheapness (value-trap risk).
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ Comparable Analysis→Operating Statistics (name vs peer median: growth/margin/leverage/beta)

bear_points.claim: The name has materially underperformed: -63.6% over 180d while the market (IWM) rose +18.0%, an -82.4% relative gap — an idiosyncratic, name-specific repricing rather than a broad sell-off.
GAAP-EPS surprises have turned negative recently (FY2023 -4%, FY2024 -0%, FY2025 -2%) after earlier beats, and consensus sits at Hold (3.00) — execution against estimates has been soft.

decisive_question.question: Is EPAM's second-half visibility shortfall a temporary, macro-driven timing shift in discretionary spend (overshoot), or the early signal of structural margin and growth erosion as AI/tokenomics reprice the services model (value trap)?

evidence_for.claim: Management calls it a temporary shift in timing and direction, with AI-native pipeline and funding remaining strong and an accelerating large-deal pipeline not yet reflected in the outlook.
evidence_for.source_ref: CIQ transcript(s): EPAM Systems, Inc., Q1 2026 Earnings Call, May 07, 2026.rtf; EPAM Systems, Inc., Q4 2025 Earnings Call, Feb 19, 2026.rtf

evidence_for.claim: Revenue still grew +7.6% YoY in Q1 Mar-2026 and absolute EBITDA rose to 731 LTM, so cash earnings power is intact despite the margin-% decline.
evidence_for.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Income Statement + Segments + Ratios (multi-year columns)

evidence_against.claim: EBITDA margin fell from 17% to 13% and gross margin from 34% to 29% across the period — a multi-year, sustained per-unit erosion, not a single-quarter dip.
evidence_against.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Income Statement (margin % + absolute EBITDA reconciler)

evidence_against.claim: Management itself flags more macro uncertainty than 90 days ago, North America underperformance, lower second-half visibility, and expected Q2 impact — posture worsened QoQ.
evidence_against.source_ref: CIQ transcript(s): EPAM Systems, Inc., Q1 2026 Earnings Call, May 07, 2026.rtf; EPAM Systems, Inc., Q4 2025 Earnings Call, Feb 19, 2026.rtf
